test_title: PYST 22: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 9th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A sum of Rs. 15,500 amounts to Rs. 19,189 in 3(1)/(2) years at a certain rate per cent per annum, at simple interest. The simple interest on the same sum at the same rate for 6(2)/(3) years will be (nearest to a Rs.):
solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs.15500

Amount = Rs.19189

Time = 7/2 years

**Formula used:**

SI = (P × R × T)/100

Rate = I(one year)/P

**Calculation:**

A = P + 7/2 × I

⇒ 15500 + 7/2 × I = 19189

⇒ 7/2 × I = 3689

I(one year) = 1054

Rate = I/P × 100

⇒ 1054/15500 × 100

⇒ 6.8%

SI = (P × R × T)/100

⇒ (15500 × 6.8 × 20)/(3 × 100)

⇒ (155 × 68 × 2)/3

⇒ 7026.66 = 7027(nearest)

**∴ The correct answer is Rs.7027.**
